Rep. Brian Mast highlights crime response and local healthcare achievements in recent posts
Rep. Brian Mast, a U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 21st district since 2017, posted several updates on his official social media account between August 11 and August 12, 2026. The posts covered public safety initiatives, constituent services, and local healthcare achievements.
On August 11, Mast referenced a federal initiative from the previous year, stating, "One year ago, President Trump declared a crime emergency in Washington, D.C. The results: 16,000+ arrests, 2,000 illegal guns off the streets & 25 missing kids home safe."
In another post on August 12, Mast addressed his constituents directly about the services offered by his congressional office: "My job in Congress is to serve you, and my team is always ready to assist. Don’t hesitate to pick up the phone if you need help."
Later that day, he acknowledged a local healthcare provider's recognition: "Proud to see Cleveland Clinic Martin Health-Stuart recognized as a top performer for Florida hospitals. Behind every rating are doctors, nurses, and staff who care for our communities. Thank you!"
Mast has represented Florida’s 21st district since succeeding Patrick Murphy in 2017 and previously served in the Florida House of Representatives. Born in Grand Rapids, Michigan in 1980 and currently residing in Fort Pierce at age 42, Mast earned his BA from Harvard University Extension School in 2016.
